title: Skeleton Jester in Hell
description: A skeletal jester in a purple suit dances with one leg raised while holding a chain, positioned beside a large cracked egg-like orb containing a screaming blonde woman's face. Above, a glowing blue and purple portal swirls within a lotus-like frame in a dark, fiery forest canopy with green trees and swirling flames.
prompt: A skeletal jester wearing a purple suit and blue spiky hair dances dynamically with one leg raised, holding a metal chain in one hand, next to a giant cracked white egg orb glowing with orange light that contains the screaming face of a blonde woman with red lips. The scene is set in a dark fantasy forest with twisted green trees and swirling flames in orange, red, and green, while a large glowing blue and purple portal framed by a lotus flower hovers in the canopy above with light rays breaking through.
